essence: One should choose one hundred learned and well-conducted brahmins.
Each of them should chant the nine-syllabled mantra ten thousand times.
After accomplishing this for ten days, one should diligently perform the fire-offering.
One should offer the nine-syllabled mantra one hundred thousand times with the previously mentioned materials.
One should honor one thousand virtuous men devoted to the worship of the goddess.
